days.title: How Groups Make Rules
days.learning_objective: Laws are rules that govern behavior in society.
learning_objectives: Define what a law is and explain its purpose in society.
Identify different types of laws and provide examples of each.
Analyze the importance of laws in maintaining order and fairness.

days.title: Rules Everyone Agrees On
days.learning_objective: Freedom allows people to make choices and express themselves.
learning_objectives: Define freedom and identify its core components.
Analyze the relationship between freedom and responsibility.
Evaluate the impact of freedom on individual expression and societal progress.

days.title: How People Trade
days.learning_objective: Peace is the absence of conflict and presence of harmony.
learning_objectives: Define peace as both the absence of conflict and the presence of harmony.
Identify personal actions that contribute to or detract from peace.
Apply conflict resolution strategies to real-life scenarios.

days.title: How Money Works
days.learning_objective: Conflict arises from disagreement or competing interests.
learning_objectives: Identify the common sources of conflict in different situations.
Apply active listening and empathy to understand different perspectives in a conflict.
Develop and practice constructive strategies for resolving conflicts effectively.

days.title: Exchanging What You Have
days.learning_objective: Negotiation finds mutually acceptable solutions to disagreements.
learning_objectives: Define negotiation and identify its key components.
Apply active listening skills to understand different perspectives.
Develop strategies for finding common ground and creating mutually beneficial solutions.

days.title: Trading Time for Value
days.learning_objective: Mediation uses a neutral party to help resolve conflicts.
learning_objectives: Define mediation and identify its key principles.
Explain the role of a mediator and their responsibilities.
Apply active listening and communication skills in a simulated mediation scenario.
Identify strategies for finding common ground and reaching a mutually agreeable solution.
Analyze the benefits and limitations of mediation in various contexts.

days.title: Keeping for Later
days.learning_objective: Forgiveness releases resentment and allows healing.
learning_objectives: Define forgiveness and differentiate it from condoning or excusing harmful behavior.
Identify the emotional and physical benefits of practicing forgiveness.
Apply practical strategies for releasing resentment and cultivating compassion.

days.title: Choosing What to Buy
days.learning_objective: Apology acknowledges wrongdoing and seeks to repair harm.
learning_objectives: Define 'apology' and explain its importance in repairing relationships.
Identify the key components of a sincere and effective apology.
Practice constructing and delivering apologies in various scenarios.
Demonstrate active listening skills to understand the impact of one's actions on others.

days.title: Sharing What You Have
days.learning_objective: Trust is confidence in someone's reliability and integrity.
learning_objectives: Define trust and identify its core components (reliability & integrity).
Explain why trust is important in various relationships (family, friends, community).
Demonstrate actions that build and maintain trust.
Recognize situations where trust has been broken and strategies for repair.

days.title: Accepting What's Given
days.learning_objective: Loyalty maintains commitment to people and principles.
learning_objectives: Define loyalty and its key characteristics.
Identify examples of loyalty in different contexts (family, friendships, community).
Explain the benefits of loyalty in building strong relationships.
Recognize the challenges to loyalty and how to overcome them.
Demonstrate loyalty in everyday interactions.

days.title: Noticing What's Good
days.learning_objective: Betrayal breaks trust through deception or disloyalty.
learning_objectives: Define betrayal and distinguish it from other negative social interactions.
Analyze the psychological impact of betrayal on individuals and relationships.
Develop effective coping strategies for dealing with betrayal and rebuilding trust.

days.title: Believing Better Is Possible
days.learning_objective: Repair restores what has been damaged or broken.
learning_objectives: Identify common types of damage in everyday objects.
Apply basic repair techniques using readily available tools and materials.
Explain the environmental and economic benefits of repair over replacement.

days.title: Believing You Can Improve
days.learning_objective: Growth mindset believes abilities can develop through effort.
learning_objectives: Define the concept of a Growth Mindset and contrast it with a Fixed Mindset.
Identify strategies for developing a Growth Mindset in everyday situations.
Apply Growth Mindset principles to overcome challenges and achieve personal goals.

days.title: When You Think You Can't Change
days.learning_objective: Fixed mindset believes abilities are unchangeable.
learning_objectives: Define fixed mindset and identify its characteristics.
Differentiate between fixed and growth mindsets.
Apply strategies to shift from a fixed mindset to a growth mindset.

days.title: The Voice in Your Head
days.learning_objective: Self-talk is the internal dialogue we have with ourselves.
learning_objectives: Define self-talk and identify examples of positive and negative self-talk.
Analyze personal self-talk patterns and recognize common negative thought traps.
Apply techniques to reframe negative thoughts into positive and empowering affirmations.

days.title: Words That Shape Beliefs
days.learning_objective: Affirmations are positive statements that build confidence.
learning_objectives: Define affirmations and explain their purpose.
Identify and challenge negative self-talk.
Create personalized, positive affirmations.
Practice using affirmations in daily situations.
Understand the connection between thoughts, feelings, and actions.

days.title: Practicing in Your Mind
days.learning_objective: Visualization imagines desired outcomes to improve performance.
learning_objectives: Define visualization and explain its purpose.
Practice basic visualization techniques for improved focus and concentration.
Apply visualization to achieve a specific personal or academic goal.

days.title: Quieting Your Thoughts
days.learning_objective: Motivation drives us to take action toward goals.
learning_objectives: Define motivation and differentiate between intrinsic and extrinsic motivation.
Identify personal values and align them with specific goals to increase motivation.
Apply strategies for overcoming procrastination and maintaining motivation during challenging tasks.

days.title: Being Where You Are
days.learning_objective: Inspiration sparks creativity and enthusiasm.
learning_objectives: Identify personal sources of inspiration.
Apply techniques to overcome creative blocks.
Articulate the connection between inspiration and enthusiasm.
Create an 'Inspiration Journal' with daily prompts.

days.title: What Makes You Come Alive
days.learning_objective: Passion is intense enthusiasm for something meaningful.
learning_objectives: Define passion and its importance in life.
Identify personal interests and potential passions.
Develop strategies to cultivate and pursue passions.
Recognize the connection between passion and resilience.

days.title: Why You Get Up
days.learning_objective: Purpose gives meaning and direction to life.
learning_objectives: Identify their core values and passions.
Articulate a personal purpose statement.
Develop an action plan to align their lives with their purpose.

days.title: What Makes Life Matter
days.learning_objective: Values are principles that guide our choices and behavior.
learning_objectives: Define personal values and explain their importance.
Identify and prioritize their own core values.
Apply their values to real-life decision-making scenarios.

days.title: Deciding Right From Wrong
days.learning_objective: Ethics are moral principles that govern behavior.
learning_objectives: Define ethics and differentiate between moral principles.
Analyze ethical dilemmas and apply ethical frameworks to make informed decisions.
Evaluate the consequences of ethical and unethical behavior in real-world scenarios.

days.title: What You Care About Most
days.learning_objective: Morality distinguishes right from wrong.
learning_objectives: Define morality and distinguish it from other value systems.
Identify and analyze different ethical perspectives and frameworks.
Apply moral reasoning to real-world dilemmas and scenarios.

days.title: Who You Are When No One's Looking
days.learning_objective: Character is the collection of qualities that define a person.
learning_objectives: Define "character" and identify its core components.
Recognize examples of strong and weak character in real-life scenarios.
Articulate how character influences decision-making and relationships.

days.title: What You Leave Behind
days.learning_objective: Wisdom applies knowledge and experience to make good judgments.
learning_objectives: Define wisdom and differentiate it from knowledge and information.
Identify and analyze real-world scenarios requiring wise decision-making.
Apply strategies for critical thinking and ethical judgment.

days.title: Looking Back to Learn
days.learning_objective: Legacy is what we leave behind for future generations.
learning_objectives: Define the concept of 'legacy' and its significance.
Identify positive and negative examples of legacies.
Brainstorm actions they can take to build a positive legacy.

days.title: Marking What Matters
days.learning_objective: Contribution adds value to the world around us.
learning_objectives: Define 'contribution' and explain its significance.
Identify personal skills and passions suitable for contributing to society.
Brainstorm and propose at least three concrete ways to contribute to their community.

days.title: Appreciating What You Have
days.learning_objective: Service helps others without expectation of reward.
learning_objectives: Define "service" and explain its importance.
Identify examples of service in everyday life.
Demonstrate an act of service without expectation of reward.

days.title: Starting Fresh
days.learning_objective: Gratitude practice regularly acknowledges what we appreciate.
learning_objectives: Define gratitude and its significance.
Identify things they are grateful for in their lives.
Practice various gratitude exercises regularly.

days.title: 365 Days of Growing
days.learning_objective: Reflection examines experiences to gain insight and wisdom.
learning_objectives: Identify personal experiences suitable for reflection.
Apply structured reflection techniques to analyze past events.
Articulate lessons learned and actionable insights from reflection.
